title: 'We were petrified': Afghan women on the tragic day the Taliban came back
subhead: 'Voices of Afghan Women' (1/6). Five years after the Taliban returned to power and imposed their archaic version of Sharia law, our special correspondent in Kabul spoke with these almost invisible women about their daily fears, the oppressive grip of family, forced marriages and their stolen dreams.

title: Adolf and Rudolf Dassler, the Cain and Abel of sports shoes
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (6/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. United by their passion for sports, the two German brothers grew their shoe factory for more than a decade. Separated by WWII, each went on to create his own brand, Adidas and Puma, through which their fierce rivalry was played out.

title: Environmental amnesia: How we can't even remember the lost biodiversity of yore
subhead: While we can recall car windshields covered with dead insects after a drive, what do we know about wolves that once roamed the countryside in the Middle Ages, or salmon swimming in the Seine in the 19th century? This gradual forgetting of what was once a teeming natural world prevents us from protecting today's nature.
